title: Check Jackson long limits and the original decimal slice contract
description: Compile the original Jackson Core 2.19.0 public caller on Temurin 21. Measure both inLongRange overloads over all 2,000 threshold inputs, parseLong19 on every accepted slice, and a separately guarded all-19-digit claim. Retain three checker outputs, reach controls and exact JVM replays.
expected: Four raw three-profile comparisons bound to the release with the finite threshold and general digit scope distinguished.
